name: cost-meter
description: Live session cost estimate in the status line, from real token usage.

pricing.title: Pricing override (JSON)
pricing.description: USD per million tokens, keyed by a model-id fragment, e.g. {"opus":{"input":5,"output":25,"cacheRead":0.5,"cacheWrite":6.25}}. cacheRead and cacheWrite default to 0.1x and 1.25x input. Empty = built-in table.

showTokens.title: Show token count
showTokens.description: Add the total token count (input, output and cache) after the cost.
